_comment: Every image the page uses: its master in img/raw/ (git-ignored, 4K where the source offers it), the widths to produce, and the credit line. tools/optimise_images.py reads this and writes img/<name>-<width>.{webp,jpg|png} plus img/CREDITS.md. Product shots keep their transparency (alpha=true -> png fallback instead of jpg). crop = [left, top, right, bottom] on the master, applied before resizing.
